newsitem.title: USA: Quantech holders approve increased shares.
newsitem.headline: Quantech holders approve increased shares.

text.p: Quantech Ltd said on Tuesday that its shareholders approved an increase in the company's authorized shares of stock to 120 million from 60 million.
At September 30, the company had 46.9 million average shares outstanding.

Quantech, a development stage company working to commercialize its surface plasmon resonance (SPR) technology for the critical care medical diagnostic market, expects to make its 510(k) submission to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in early 1997 and launch its product next summer.

"We have engaged consultants in the areas of regulatory affairs, project management, mathematics, software design, market research, industrial design and product engineering. This group adds to the critical mass required to complete the final commercialization of our diagnostic product," said president R.H. Joseph Shaw.
"We believe that our current funds are sufficient to allow us to make the FDA submission," Shaw added.
